DIAGNOSIS READY: Jejunocolic Atresia

The clinical picture of an 8-month-old with severe feeding difficulties, abdominal distension, and bilious vomiting is highly suggestive of a mid-gut obstruction, specifically jejunocolic atresia given the chronicity and age of presentation. The abdominal X-ray results are critical to confirm the level of obstruction and the presence of the characteristic "step-ladder" appearance of air-fluid levels. Please review the abdominal X-ray images immediately to finalize the surgical planning.
